steps.en: Install the library and CLI with the signing extras you need
steps.zh: 安装库与 CLI，并选择所需签名扩展

steps.en: Provide a PDF, signature field, certificate, and private key
steps.zh: 提供 PDF、签名字段、证书和私钥
steps.code: pyhanko sign addsig --field Sig1 pkcs12 input.pdf output.pdf secrets.pfx

steps.en: Hashes the PDF and creates the CMS signature container
steps.zh: 计算 PDF 摘要并创建 CMS 签名容器

steps.en: Writes an incremental revision that preserves earlier signed bytes
steps.zh: 写入增量修订，保留先前已签名字节

value.en: The PDF carries a certificate-backed signature without rewriting its prior revisions
value.zh: PDF 获得证书签名，同时不重写先前修订
